card.name: Quantifier slots like 'in patients', 'in some'
card.fires_on: Small words such as 'in', 'some', 'all' or 'days' right where a group, proportion or range is about to be stated (e.g. 'in the majority of cases', 'in patients ranging from').

modes.label: 'in' before a group or range
modes.description: The word 'in' after a time, dose or treatment phrase, leading into patients, cases or a range.
